fallback: no candidate or fractional-incomplete phase result invokes an independent packed FP64 V4 blind call; attempt and fallback are both charged; a complete margin-negative is final

timing.order: alternate independent reference-first and complete-strategy-first per repetition
timing.aggregation: per-case median thread CPU and monotonic wall; totals sum per-case medians

excluded: threshold or alias-offset tuning after outcomes
